notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.notes:
Welcome adventurer to the newest update of our RPG game!
Are you ready to explore the mysteries of a dark and dangerous cave?

Deep in the heart of the swamps lies a hidden cave, unknown to most but rumored to be filled with treasure and danger. Only the bravest of souls dare to enter, for within its depths lurks unknown perils and untold riches.

The cave entrance is shrouded in darkness, but with a trusty torch in hand, you bravely enter the depths. The damp walls echo with the sound of your footsteps as you delve deeper into the unknown. Suddenly, you see a glint of light in the distance, and you know you are close to your goal.

As you approach the source of the light, you find yourself face-to-face with a mysterious figure. Is it a witch? Is it a sorceress? You can't quite make out her features in the dimly lit cavern, but she beckons you closer with a crooked finger.

With a chill running down your spine, you realize that you are not alone in this cave. You hear the skittering of many legs and a faint rustling sound. What could it be? You hesitate, but the witch urges you forward, promising you untold riches and powerful magic.

As you follow her deeper into the cave, you come across a massive web stretching across the cavern walls. It is the home of a giant spider, its eight eyes glowing in the darkness. You shudder with fear, but the witch seems unfazed, as if she has some kind of control over the beast.

You can't help but feel that you've stumbled upon something much larger than a simple cave. What secrets lie in this mysterious place? Will you uncover the witch's true intentions, and survive the deadly spider's attack? Only the bravest adventurers will dare to enter and find out.

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Main Notes:


 Outfits preparation
 Adjustment of the Druid's healing spells, which previously failed when a creature was selected. Now, when a creature is selected, the spell will heal the Druid or another player if selected.
 Correction of the attack values for some forged weapons that were incorrect.
 Correction of minor bugs.

notes.notes: Small Bug Fixes and improvement of security layer

notes.title: Update 0.7.8
notes.notes:
Dear player,

We are pleased to inform you that the maintenance on The Magic Land game server is now complete. We have successfully resolved the issues caused by recent attacks, and our server is now available and stable for your gameplay experience.

We want to let you know that this was an emergency maintenance to address critical issues, and we are aware that there is still much work to be done to make the game even safer. We want to assure you that we are taking all necessary steps to enhance the security of our systems and prevent similar incidents from happening in the future.

We appreciate your understanding and support as we work to make The Magic Land a safe and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. If you experience any further issues or have any concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team. We are here to help and provide you with the best possible experience.

Thank you for playing The Magic Land, and we look forward to seeing you in the game.

Best regards,
Racs Studio.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow adventurers! 

We are excited to announce a major update to our MMORPG game, introducing a new feature: Forging! 

With this new feature, players will be able to forge powerful items to help them on their journey. The forged Items will be unique and powerful, and will give players an edge in battle. We hope you are as excited as we are about this new feature, and we look forward to seeing what you can create! 

Happy forging!

notes.title: Update 0.7.4
notes.notes:
Attention all MMORPG players!

We are excited to announce a brand new update to our game that will make your gaming experience even better! Our latest update includes the addition of a new account creation button directly on the main menu of the game, making it easier than ever to create an account and start playing.

But that's not all! We've also added social media buttons to the main menu, allowing you to easily connect with other players and share your gaming experiences on your favorite platforms. With these new features, you can create an account, connect with friends, and jump right into the action in no time.

So what are you waiting for? Update your game today and take advantage of these exciting new features! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update Patch 0.7.2
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We would like to share with you the latest updates of our game. Starting from update 03/09/2023, we are implementing the following changes to improve gameplay and user experience:

We have reduced the respawn time of some creatures to make battles more dynamic and exciting.
We have increased the selling price of some loot items so that players can obtain more gold in the early stages of the game.
We have made a significant increase in the drop rate of items that are not yet forgeable but are more powerful, especially in bosses.
We have released the windows for outfits and forged items, allowing players to view their items. However, forgeable items and outfits are not yet available in this update.
We have prepared the backend for the implementation of premium accounts, which will provide access to exclusive content and other benefits.
We have made minor bug fixes to improve game stability.
We appreciate your continued support and hope that you enjoy these updates.

Best regards,

Racs Studio
